items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I was in shows and then I worked with Pearl Bailey.

ctx.x: No, yeah, in the '40's and into the you know, early '50's, you were still obviously working in the shows.
I was still doing the shows. I was in shows and then I worked with Pearl Bailey. The Louie Belson band worked with Don Redman (inaudible). We traveled a little bit.
